proc closeLLMStore(store: Store) {....raises: [IOError],
                                   tags: [TimeEffect, WriteIOEffect],
                                   forbids: [].}
Flushes and closes the LLM store, releasing its lock. Call after every use so concurrent shells never block on a held handle. Best-effort: the reference is always dropped so the OS lock is released regardless.
